pcs.pc_description: interact with data science and engineering teams to contribute to overall project development
evaluate business contexts and identify the true definition of the data being annotated for specific use cases
identify the primary types of already determined data, relevant to the project (text, audio, image, and video)
search for data sources and data sets according to a defined keyword
garner the pre-processed data after data cleaning and profiling from the data science team
identify data sensitivities (PHI, PII, etc.) for masked and encrypted data
classify the different data elements as sentiments, semantics, intent, and named entities
recognize relevant annotation methods based on the data types, elements, ML algorithms being used, the business case and its expected outcomes
identify and analyze the domain vocabulary, language, format, and category of data intended to be used
label the data accordingly as per the type of annotation and output required
ensure proper organization and formatting of the training data
Address uncertain cases where it may be unclear how to annotate certain elements, often requiring consultation with supervisors or reference to more comprehensive guidelines.
Use specialized annotation tools and software to perform tagging and labeling efficiently
Ensure accuracy in labeling by reviewing annotations and performing checks to ensure consistency

pcs.pc_description: Develop detailed documentation that outlines how to annotate various elements, including examples and edge cases.
Define the metrics such as precision, recall, and F1-score that help evaluate the quality of the annotations.
Randomly selecting samples of annotated data and reviewing them against the established guidelines to check for accuracy.
Ensure that annotations are consistent across similar instances. For example, if two annotators label similar images differently, this inconsistency needs to be addressed.
Employ and follow pre-defined methods to ensure accuracy of annotation models and techniques
Review the annotated data and conduct periodic validations adhering to all the required standards
Apply or execute cross-checking mechanisms to ensure wrongful labelling is not performed
Adhere to the defined data quality standards to secure the ground data and annotated data from corruption and leakage
Provide inputs to data engineers on tooling and processes for more efficient labeling, and to improve data quality
Execute methods to identify misclassified content
Suggest changes in annotation schemes if and when required
Help create open-source datasets with the right annotation for an unbiased evaluation of annotation models
Recommend improvements to annotation tools or workflows to enhance efficiency and accuracy
Assist in evaluating new data annotation platforms or toolkits, ensuring they align with the project’s technical requirements and annotation standards
